title: Standard cancellation policy
conditions: Use the recorded booking channel and cancellation status
exclusions: Does not determine disputed cancellation source
summary: Cancellation outcomes depend on verified booking records and approved exceptions.

title: Refund processing policy
conditions: Verify payment and refund status before communicating progress
summary: Refund status may be reported from records; eligibility and adjustments require approval.

title: Duplicate payment and billing-dispute policy
summary: Payment discrepancies must be verified and financial changes approved.

title: Overbooking relocation and compensation policy
summary: Verified overbooking requires urgent duty-manager escalation; compensation is not automatic.

title: Guest-safety escalation policy
conditions: Prioritise immediate safety and local assistance
exclusions: Do not declare an incident resolved
summary: Safety reports require immediate escalation and careful preservation of facts.

title: Guest-data privacy policy
exclusions: Do not disclose unrelated guest data
summary: Suspected guest-data exposure requires privacy escalation and data minimisation.

title: Accessibility support policy
conditions: Use recorded needs and property capabilities
exclusions: Do not assume an accommodation is suitable
summary: Accessibility needs must be verified and unmet requirements escalated.

title: Check-in and identity-verification policy
conditions: Verify booking and recorded check-in status
summary: Check-in exceptions require verified booking context and property approval.

title: Room-quality remediation policy
conditions: Verify active stay and document issue
exclusions: Do not promise upgrades or compensation
summary: Room concerns are documented and routed to property operations; remedies require approval.

title: Guest communication policy
exclusions: Do not promise product delivery dates
summary: Guest feedback may be acknowledged and routed without operational commitments.
